title: focuser_optec descriptor_cleanup integration case fails on master
summary: Integration case descriptor_cleanup in indigo_test/integration/test_focuser_optec_simulator.c:762 fails (open_descriptors() != before) on master e7cbb62a6 in 3 of 3 filtered runs and on the task candidate. Either the driver/simulator leaks a descriptor across the case or the test counts an unrelated descriptor. Next: scoped focuser_optec task to identify the leaked descriptor and fix the driver or the test contract.
